sources: Domain knowledge on Indian music (not live-verified); lab findings lab/results.md R5, M2, lang-probe; pool vocab apps/web/lib/pool/tags.ts; festival dates from calendar knowledge (verify).

lyria_vocal_scale.good: tested and reliable in lab or pool
lyria_vocal_scale.ok: plausible, tested for the language but not the style
lyria_vocal_scale.risky: melismatic or classical; expect diction loss; budget extra renders and run diction gate

styles.name: Khayal, slow (bada khayal)
styles.region: North India (gharana tradition: Gwalior, Kirana, Agra, Jaipur-Atrauli)
styles.lyric_form: Bandish of two parts: sthayi, antara; short poem in Braj/Hindi, 2 to 8 lines, sung with long alap, vistar, taan
styles.metre: free-metre poem fitted to tala; 1 to 4 lines repeat as refrain
styles.raga_hint: Time-bound: Bhairav/Todi dawn, Yaman/Marwa dusk, Malkauns/Darbari night
styles.lyria_hint_native: हिंदुस्तानी ख़याल, अति विलंबित एकताल, तानपुरा, तबला, सारंगी, गहरी आलाप, शास्त्रीय पुरुष स्वर
styles.lyria_hint_en: Hindustani khayal, very slow vilambit ektal, tanpura drone, tabla, sarangi, long alap, trained male voice, raga-appropriate for the hour
styles.lyria_note: Lyria tends to sing wordless alap and may ignore the bandish text; expect low diction match. Use as a short alap-style intro or a light-classical hybrid, not a pure khayal.

styles.name: Khayal, fast (chhota khayal) and tarana
styles.lyric_form: Short bandish, 4 to 8 lines, with sargam and taan; tarana uses meaningless syllables (ta na dir dir)
styles.metre: 8 to 16 beat cycle; syllabic, no lexical meaning in tarana
styles.lyria_hint_native: द्रुत तीनताल बंदिश, तेज़ तान और सरगम, हारमोनियम, तबला, राग भूपाली या बहार
styles.lyria_hint_en: Fast Hindustani chhota khayal in drut teental, rapid taans and sargam, tabla, harmonium, bright raga (Bhoopali or Bahar)
styles.lyria_note: Fast taans are where synthetic voices sound least natural (judge: stiff rhythm, vowel sustain). Tarana syllables avoid diction scoring problems but have no lyric content for PCE.

styles.name: Dhrupad
styles.lyric_form: Four-part composition: sthayi, antara, sanchari, abhog; Sanskrit/Braj, devotional, seasonal, praise
styles.metre: even syllabic metre set to 10-14 beat cycles; text is secondary to nom-tom alap
styles.lyria_hint_native: ध्रुपद गायन, पखावज, तानपुरा, चौताल, गंभीर धीमी नोम-तोम आलाप, ब्रजभाषा, पुरुष स्वर
styles.lyria_hint_en: Dhrupad: deep male voice, pakhawaj, tanpura, slow nom-tom alap, chautal, austere and meditative
styles.lyria_note: Rare, no pop-ish features. Pakhawaj is poorly rendered by general music models. Park until a human check exists.

styles.name: Thumri and dadra
styles.lyric_form: Romantic-devotional lyric, Radha-Krishna and separation (viraha); short 2 to 6 line text expressed through bol-banao (melodic elaboration)
styles.lyria_hint_native: ठुमरी, पूरबी अंग, दादरा ताल, हारमोनियम, सारंगी, श्रृंगार रस, कोमल स्त्री स्वर, बोल बनाव
styles.lyria_hint_en: Thumri in Purab ang, dadra 6 beats, harmonium and sarangi, tender female voice, shringar rasa, expressive ornaments
styles.lyria_note: Good candidate for Lyria vocals: slow, lyric, single voice. Expect Hindi/Urdu phrasing rather than Braj. Keep text in simple Hindi.

styles.name: Seasonal light classical: chaiti, kajri, hori, sawan jhula
styles.lyric_form: Seasonal folk-classical couplets: chaiti (spring, Chaitra), kajri (monsoon), hori (Holi), jhula (swing)
styles.lyria_hint_native: चैती, कजरी, सावन का झूला, होरी, ढोलक, हारमोनियम, पूर्वांचल लोक-शास्त्रीय, महिला कोरस
styles.lyria_hint_en: Seasonal chaiti/kajri/hori from eastern Uttar Pradesh, dholak and harmonium, women's chorus, swing rhythm
styles.lyria_note: Folk-light: Lyria usually handles dholak plus female chorus well. Tie to monsoon/Holi/Chaitra in the station calendar.

styles.name: Instrumental raga (alap, jod, jhala, gat)
styles.lyric_form: Wordless; structure alap, jod, jhala, then composed gat in a tala
styles.tala: Teental, jhaptal, rupak, ektal; alap has no tala
styles.raga_hint: Dawn Bhairav/Ahir Bhairav, midday Madhyamad Sarang, dusk Marwa/Puriya, night Yaman/Malkauns
styles.lyria_hint_native: सितार और तबला, राग यमन, आलाप जोड़ झाला, गत तीनताल, केवल वाद्य
styles.lyria_hint_en: Instrumental raga: sitar or bansuri with tabla and tanpura, alap then gat, no singing, no humming, no vocalise
styles.lyria_note: LAB R5: classical prompts vocalised in 10 of 13 renders, raga+folk+devotional 75 to 100 percent of the time. Do not target the instrumental pool with raga prompts. Only santoor (Marwa, 'dusk-santoor-marwa') and a piano raga passed the gate. Use a 'wordless vocalise' pool kind if S wants dawn/dusk raga.

styles.name: Shehnai mangal dhwani
styles.lyric_form: Wordless auspicious invocation; Bismillah Khan tradition
styles.lyria_hint_native: शहनाई मंगल ध्वनि, तबला, नगाड़ा, शादी का स्वागत, शुभ आरंभ, केवल वाद्य
styles.lyria_hint_en: Shehnai mangal dhwani for a wedding entrance, tabla and nagara, auspicious and warm, instrumental only
styles.lyria_note: Passed: 'festive-wedding-shehnai' in lab but with vocal blips risk; strict no-vocals prompt still needs the gate. Good for wedding station idents.

styles.name: Ghazal (Urdu/Hindi)
styles.lyric_form: Series of independent couplets (sher); matla opening, radif refrain, qafia rhyme, maqta with poet's pen name
styles.metre: bahr (Arabic-Persian quantitative metres, 19 standard); 12 to 20 syllable lines; AA BA CA rhyme
styles.lyria_hint_native: ग़ज़ल, उर्दू शायरी, मतला और रदीफ़, हारमोनियम, तबला, सारंगी, धीमी कहरवा ताल, मखमली पुरुष स्वर
styles.lyria_hint_en: Ghazal with matla and radif, slow kaharwa, harmonium, tabla, sarangi, velvet male or sweet female voice, nostalgic
styles.lyria_note: Lab: rainy-guitar-ghazal passed generation; vocal ghazal needs Urdu register discipline from PCE. Ghazal is Urdu-leaning, so ur support (RTL render) is the blocker for the script, not Lyria.
must_avoid: 'dil' in both lines of every sher

styles.name: Qawwali
styles.region: Delhi, Ajmer, Hyderabad, Lahore, Punjab (Chishti Sufi tradition)
styles.lyric_form: Devotional poetry in Persian, Urdu, Punjabi, Braj; hamd, naat, manqabat, marifat; call-and-response
styles.lyria_hint_native: क़व्वाली, तालियाँ, ढोलक, हारमोनियम, कोरस, धीमी शुरुआत से तेज़ उफ़ान, सूफ़ी रंग
styles.lyria_hint_en: Qawwali: rhythmic hand claps, dholak, harmonium, male lead with chorus, slow start building to a trance climax
styles.lyria_note: LAB M2: the qawwali and duet profiles were the only ones that visibly changed the arrangement; hi-qawwali-m-2 pronunciation passed. Keep to universal Sufi themes (love, longing, the Beloved); avoid religious figures.
styles.sensitivity: Religious poetry: no depiction or speech put in the mouth of religious figures; stay with universal themes (safety-legal.md)

styles.name: Sufi kalam
styles.region: Punjab, Sindh, Delhi (Bulleh Shah, Waris Shah, Amir Khusrau, Baba Farid, Kabir)
styles.lyric_form: Mystical short poems (kafi); love of the Beloved; Punjabi kafi, Urdu/Hindi kalam
styles.lyria_hint_native: सूफ़ियाना कलाम, दफ़, हारमोनियम, गिटार, रूहानी गहरी आवाज़, धीमी बढ़त
styles.lyria_hint_en: Modern Sufi kalam, daf, harmonium, guitar, soulful voice, gradual build; public-domain poets only if lyric reuse
styles.lyria_note: LAB: sufi instrumental generated but vocalised both times; as a vocal track it is the natural fit. Original lyrics only; classic kalam by dead poets may be quoted only if public domain and attributed.

styles.name: Bhajan (nirgun and sagun)
styles.region: North India (Kabir, Meera, Tulsidas, Surdas, Sant Ravidas)
styles.lyric_form: Devotional hymn to a deity (sagun) or the formless (nirgun); simple 4 to 8 line verses with repeating refrain
styles.metre: even-line couplets, 8 to 12 syllables; refrain repeated
styles.lyria_hint_native: भजन, हारमोनियम, ढोलक, मंजीरा, कोरस, सुबह की भक्ति, सरल दोहराव वाली पंक्तियाँ
styles.lyria_hint_en: Morning bhajan, harmonium, dholak, manjira, women's chorus, simple repeating refrain, devotional and warm
styles.lyria_note: LAB M2: bhajan profile produced accepted Hindi (bhajan-m-1 flagged AI-sounding); the vocal render is dependable, the instrumental raga/devotional is not.

styles.name: Aarti and stuti
styles.lyric_form: Ritual lamp-waving hymn with chorus; Sanskrit/Hindi stuti
styles.metre: 4-beat bounce, building refrain; fixed text traditionally
styles.lyria_hint_native: आरती, घंटी, शंख, ढोलक, मंजीरा, सामूहिक गायन, सुबह-शाम की पूजा
styles.lyria_hint_en: Temple aarti with bells, conch, dholak, manjira, group chorus, steady rhythm that quickens
styles.lyria_note: Traditional texts are public-domain; fresh aartis fine. Offer around dawn/dusk and Diwali.
styles.sensitivity: Deity names are fine; no claims about believers/non-believers

styles.name: Bollywood / Hindi film pop
styles.lyric_form: Mukhda/antara with hook; romantic, item, party, wedding, sad-lover
styles.metre: 8 to 12 syllables per line, antyaprasa end-rhyme, 4-line antara
styles.lyria_hint_native: बॉलीवुड पॉप, कैची मुखड़ा, सिंथ, ढोल, आधुनिक प्रोडक्शन, मधुर पुरुष और महिला गायन
styles.lyria_hint_en: Contemporary Bollywood pop, catchy mukhda, synth, dhol, big chorus, polished production
styles.lyria_note: Core of the live pool. Lab mood tags: drive-filmpop-groove passed as instrumental.

styles.name: Hindi retro film melody (50s to 80s)
styles.lyric_form: Melodic ballads and disco-era numbers
styles.lyria_hint_native: सत्तर के दशक की रेट्रो फ़िल्मी धुन, ऑर्केस्ट्रा स्ट्रिंग्स, सितार, एनालॉग बास, सुरीली आवाज़
styles.lyria_hint_en: 1970s Hindi film melody with string section, sitar flourishes, tabla, warm analogue bass; or 1980s disco with brass
styles.lyria_note: Lab: filmpop-retro-disco exists in m3. Style references are fine; do not name living singers or composers in prompts.

styles.name: Hindi indie / acoustic folk-pop
styles.lyric_form: Singer-songwriter verse/chorus, conversational Hindi or Hinglish
styles.lyria_hint_native: हिंदी इंडी फ़ोक, अकूस्टिक गिटार, कैज़ोन, कोमल आवाज़, शहर की शाम
styles.lyria_hint_en: Hindi indie folk-pop, acoustic guitar, cajon, gentle conversational vocal, evening city mood
styles.lyria_note: M2: hi-indie-f-2 accepted. Default for 'me-time' requests.

styles.name: Lori (lullaby, Hindi)
styles.lyric_form: Soft repeating lullaby addressed to a child; mother/grandmother voice
styles.metre: 3 to 4 line verses, simple end-rhyme, soothing repetition
styles.lyria_hint_native: लोरी, धीमी कोमल धुन, बांसुरी, हल्का हारमोनियम, माँ की मीठी आवाज़, नींद
styles.lyria_hint_en: Hindi lori, very soft, slow sway, flute and light harmonium, mother's gentle voice, sleepy
styles.lyria_note: LAB: sleep instruments (flute-rain, veena) pass about half the time. Vocal lullabies are easier than instrumental. Good for the 'Sleep' station.

styles.name: Vivah geet and sangeet songs (north Indian wedding)
styles.lyric_form: Ritual wedding songs: haldi, mehendi, banna-banni, gaari (teasing), vidaai
styles.metre: couplet + refrain, call-and-response by women's chorus
styles.lyria_hint_native: विवाह गीत, ढोलक, थाली की ताल, महिलाओं का कोरस, हल्दी मेहंदी, छेड़छाड़ वाले बोल
styles.lyria_hint_en: North Indian wedding songs, dholak and thali, women's chorus, playful teasing, joyful
styles.lyria_note: Wedding is a launch hook. Keep teasing songs gentle (moderation); vidaai is emotional and calm.

styles.name: Bhojpuri sohar, chaiti, kajri
styles.lyric_form: Seasonal and ritual couplets: sohar (birth), chaiti (spring longing), kajri (monsoon)
styles.lyria_hint_native: सोहर, चैता, कजरी, भोजपुरी लोकगीत, ढोलक, हारमोनियम, झाल, महिला स्वर, पुरबिया बोली
styles.lyria_hint_en: Bhojpuri sohar, chaita or kajri, dholak, jhal, harmonium, women's voices, village feeling
styles.lyria_note: UNTESTED. language-expansion.md risk: Lyria may sing Bhojpuri as Hindi. Wave 2. Family-safe moderation list required.

styles.name: Birha and bidesia
styles.region: Bhojpur, Ahir community, migrant labour belt
styles.lyric_form: Narrative separation (viraha) and migration (bidesia); Bhikhari Thakur tradition
styles.lyria_hint_native: बिरहा, बिदेसिया, भोजपुरी विरह गीत, ढोलक, झाल, परदेस गए पिया की याद
styles.lyria_hint_en: Bhojpuri birha or bidesia, dholak and jhal, plaintive male voice, longing for the absent migrant
styles.lyria_note: UNTESTED. Strong cultural fit with migrant listeners (diaspora wedge). Wave 2.

styles.name: Chhath geet
styles.region: Bihar, eastern UP, Jharkhand, Nepal Terai (Sharda Sinha tradition)
styles.lyric_form: Devotional songs to Surya and Chhathi Maiya; collected as ritual songs by women
styles.lyria_hint_native: छठ गीत, छठी मईया, सूरज को अर्घ्य, महिला स्वर, ढोलक, सुबह और शाम का घाट
styles.lyria_hint_en: Chhath geet at the riverbank, women's voices, dholak, devotional and serene; dawn and dusk
styles.lyria_note: UNTESTED. Seasonal (Oct/Nov): Chhath 2026 falls about 14 to 16 Nov, a week after Diwali (date to verify). Strong seasonal hook for Bhojpuri/Hindi.

styles.name: Kriti (Carnatic)
styles.region: South India (Trinity: Tyagaraja, Dikshitar, Syama Sastri; Papanasam Sivan, Purandara Dasa)
styles.lyric_form: Pallavi, anupallavi, charanam(s), with sangatis (melodic variations); devotional, composer's signature (mudra) in the last line
styles.metre: fixed tala, line lengths balanced by matra; dvitiyakshara prasa in Telugu, edugai in Tamil
styles.tala: Adi (8), rupaka (6), misra chapu (7), khanda chapu (5), triputa
styles.raga_hint: Mohanam, Kalyani, Hamsadhwani, Bhairavi, Madhyamavati, Shankarabharanam
styles.lyria_hint_native: கர்நாடக சங்கீதம் கீர்த்தனை, வீணை, வயலின், மிருதங்கம், ஆதி தாளம், பல்லவி அனுபல்லவி சரணம்
styles.lyria_hint_en: Carnatic kriti in adi tala, veena, violin and mridangam, pallavi anupallavi charanam, pure devotional, gamaka-rich male or female voice
styles.lyria_note: LAB: classical prompts vocalised in 10 of 13 instrumental attempts. As a vocal track the issue is diction: Lyria will lengthen vowels (gamaka) and the diction gate may score lower. Test 5 renders per language before launch.

styles.name: Annamayya sankirtana (Telugu)
styles.lyric_form: Pallavi + charanams, devotional to Venkateswara, spiritual-erotic (adhyatma, shringara) strands
styles.metre: line length ~8 to 12 syllables, pairs with prasa
styles.lyria_hint_native: అన్నమయ్య సంకీర్తన, తిరుమల వెంకటేశ్వరుడు, పల్లవి చరణం, వీణ, వయోలిన్, మృదంగం, భక్తి
styles.lyria_hint_en: Annamayya sankirtana, devotional Telugu, pallavi and charanam, veena, violin, mridangam, clear and devout voice
styles.lyria_note: Text is older than copyright; original new compositions fine. Telugu is a live language.

styles.name: Suprabhatam and stotram (morning waking hymns)
styles.region: South India (Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam, Kausalya Supraja)
styles.lyric_form: Sanskrit shloka waking-the-deity verses; Margazhi Thiruppavai/Thiruvempavai in Tamil
styles.lyria_hint_native: சுப்ரபாதம், திருப்பாவை, நாதஸ்வரம், மணி, அதிகாலை, மெல்லிய தம்பூரா
styles.lyria_hint_en: Suprabhatam at dawn, soft nadaswaram, veena and bells, free-flowing shloka chant, serene
styles.lyria_note: Traditional texts are public domain; a new AI performance is fine with the AI label. Margazhi (mid-Dec to mid-Jan) is a Tamil/Telugu seasonal hook.

styles.name: Padam and javali
styles.lyric_form: Slow love lyric for dance (nayika-nayaka); javali is lighter and quicker
styles.metre: ornate slow tempo, 2 to 3 line charanams
styles.lyria_hint_native: పదం జావళి, భరతనాట్యం, ప్రేమ గీతం, వీణ, వయోలిన్, మృదంగం, నెమ్మదిగా భావోద్వేగం
styles.lyria_hint_en: Padam or javali for Bharatanatyam, slow romantic Carnatic lyric, veena, violin, mridangam, emotive
styles.lyria_note: Rare in listener demand; dance-station niche. Later.

styles.name: Tillana
styles.lyric_form: Fast rhythmic dance finale with jati syllables (tom, dhim, ta, dhi) and a short lyric
styles.lyria_hint_native: தில்லானா, ஜதி, மிருதங்கம், வயலின், புல்லாங்குழல், வேகமான நடன முடிவு
styles.lyria_hint_en: Carnatic tillana, rapid jati syllables, mridangam and violin, bright energetic finale
styles.lyria_note: Syllables without lexical meaning sidestep the diction gate (nothing to match). Lyria drum/violin interplay is a plausible fit; test.

styles.name: Carnatic instrumental (veena, violin, flute, nadaswaram)
styles.lyric_form: Wordless; varnam, kriti on instruments, ragam-tanam-pallavi
styles.lyria_hint_native: வீணை, வயலின், புல்லாங்குழல், மிருதங்கம், ஆதி தாளம், கர்நாடக சங்கீதம் கருவி இசை
styles.lyria_hint_en: Carnatic instrumental, veena and violin duet, mridangam, adi tala, wordless, no humming
styles.lyria_note: LAB: dawn-veena-alap, evening-violin-carnatic, sleep-veena: veena passed ('sleep-veena') but classical overall 3 of 13 clean. Nadaswaram dawn soft passed intermittently.

styles.name: Nadaswaram and thavil (temple/wedding)
styles.region: Tamil Nadu, Andhra temples and weddings
styles.lyric_form: Auspicious loud outdoor ensemble; wordless
styles.lyria_hint_native: நாதஸ்வரம், தவில், கெட்டி மேளம், திருமண மங்கல இசை, பண்டிகை
styles.lyria_hint_en: Nadaswaram and thavil mangala vadyam for a Tamil wedding, bright festive, instrumental
styles.lyria_note: LAB: dawn-nadaswaram-soft generated (soft). Use for wedding idents and Pongal package.

styles.name: Thevaram, Tiruppugazh, Divya Prabandham (Tamil devotional)
styles.lyric_form: Tamil Shaivite and Vaishnavite hymns; Tiruppugazh in chandam rhythmic syllables for Murugan; Thiruppavai in Margazhi
styles.metre: Tamil pann-based; chanda metre; 30 Thiruppavai verses
styles.tala: Adi, misra chapu, khanda chapu, tisra
styles.lyria_hint_native: தேவாரம், திருப்புகழ், திருப்பாவை, முருகன் பக்தி, மணி ஓசை, குழுவாக பாடல்
styles.lyria_hint_en: Tamil Tiruppugazh or Thevaram, devout chorus, violin and mridangam, rhythmic syllables, dawn temple feeling
styles.lyria_note: Ta live. Texts are ancient (public domain). Murugan, Amman and Ayyappan bhakti are mass-market in Tamil Nadu.

styles.lyric_form: Folk-style devotional songs to Ayyappan, Mariamman, Murugan; chorus-friendly
styles.lyria_hint_native: ஐயப்பன் பக்தி பாடல், அம்மன் பாடல், உடுக்கை, பறை, குழு பாடல், கார்த்திகை மாதம்
styles.lyria_hint_en: Tamil Ayyappan or Amman devotional song, udukkai and parai drums, chorus, spirited devotion
styles.lyria_note: Seasonal: Sabarimala mala period starts Karthigai/Vrischikam (mid-Nov). Strong seasonal hook for Tamil and Malayalam audiences.

styles.name: Tamil film melody and pop
styles.lyric_form: Pallavi + charanams with strong melody; hook-led, quatrain lines with edugai
styles.lyria_hint_native: தமிழ் திரைப்பட மெலடி, இனிய பல்லவி, ஸ்ட்ரிங்ஸ், கிட்டார், புல்லாங்குழல், நவீன இசை அமைப்பு
styles.lyria_hint_en: Tamil film melody, memorable pallavi, strings, guitar, flute, polished modern production
styles.lyria_note: Ta is live and tested in the pool.
